SELECT json_build_object(
  'lead', (SELECT row_to_json(x) FROM (
     SELECT id, first_name, last_name, segment, service_interest, status, ai_paused
     FROM leads WHERE id = $1::uuid AND is_demo) x),
  'messages', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(m ORDER BY m.created_at) FROM (
     SELECT direction, body, created_at FROM messages WHERE lead_id = $1::uuid) m), '[]'::json),
  'booking', (SELECT row_to_json(b) FROM (
     SELECT starts_at, status FROM bookings
     WHERE lead_id = $1::uuid AND status = 'scheduled'
     ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) b)
) AS result;

WITH a AS (DELETE FROM n8n_chat_histories WHERE session_id = $1::text),
     b AS (DELETE FROM messages WHERE lead_id = $1::uuid),
     c AS (DELETE FROM bookings WHERE lead_id = $1::uuid),
     d AS (DELETE FROM lead_events WHERE lead_id = $1::uuid
           AND event_type IN ('opener_sent','followup_sent','booked','opted_out','blocked_false_booking','marked_cold'))
UPDATE leads
SET status = 'segmented', opted_out = false, opted_out_at = NULL, ai_paused = false,
    followup_count = 0, last_inbound_at = NULL, last_outbound_at = NULL,
    next_action_at = NULL, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::uuid AND is_demo
RETURNING id, status;

SELECT json_build_object(
  'kpis', (SELECT json_build_object(
      'eligible',  count(*) FILTER (WHERE segment IS NOT NULL),
      'contacted', count(*) FILTER (WHERE segment IS NOT NULL AND last_outbound_at IS NOT NULL),
      'replied',   count(*) FILTER (WHERE segment IS NOT NULL AND last_inbound_at IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'opted_out'),
      'booked',    count(*) FILTER (WHERE segment IS NOT NULL AND status = 'booked'),
      'opted_out', count(*) FILTER (WHERE segment IS NOT NULL AND status = 'opted_out'),
      'pipeline',  coalesce(sum(est_value) FILTER (WHERE segment IS NOT NULL AND status = 'booked'), 0),
      'texts_sent', (SELECT count(*) FROM lead_events WHERE event_type IN ('opener_sent','followup_sent'))
    ) FROM leads),
  'segments', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(s ORDER BY s.leads DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT segment,
             count(*) AS leads,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_outbound_at IS NOT NULL) AS contacted,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_inbound_at IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'opted_out') AS replied,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'booked') AS booked,
             coalesce(sum(est_value) FILTER (WHERE status = 'booked'), 0) AS pipeline
      FROM leads WHERE segment IS NOT NULL GROUP BY segment) s),
  'daily', (SELECT json_agg(d ORDER BY d.day) FROM (
      SELECT g.day::date AS day,
             (SELECT count(*) FROM lead_events e WHERE e.event_type IN ('opener_sent','followup_sent') AND e.created_at::date = g.day::date) AS texts,
             (SELECT count(*) FROM leads l WHERE l.segment IS NOT NULL AND l.status <> 'opted_out' AND l.last_inbound_at::date = g.day::date) AS replies,
             (SELECT count(*) FROM lead_events e WHERE e.event_type = 'booked' AND e.created_at::date = g.day::date) AS bookings
      FROM generate_series(current_date - 13, current_date, interval '1 day') AS g(day)) d),
  'recent', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT e.event_type, l.first_name, l.segment, e.created_at
      FROM lead_events e JOIN leads l ON l.id = e.lead_id
      WHERE e.event_type IN ('opener_sent','followup_sent','booked','opted_out','marked_cold')
      ORDER BY e.created_at DESC LIMIT 8) r)
) AS result;
